notes: KNOWN FAILING (daemon=bug), and the spec deliberately asserts the CORRECT behavior rather than the buggy one. One trivial turn ('What is 6 times 7?') in an interactive GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.77 session, REPL left alive at recording end. WHAT PASSES: the state arc and the model. Copilot's turn boundaries are explicit (user.message → working, assistant.turn_end → turn_done → ready) and the model is carried on three transcript events the parser reads — session.model_change(data.newModel), session.auto_mode_resolved(data.chosenModel), assistant.message(data.model) — with the concrete label landing BEFORE the first turn completes, so model_name is a real Copilot string (gpt-5-mini or claude-haiku-4.5), never 'unknown' and never the placeholder 'auto'. WHAT FAILS, AND WHY: context_window_nonzero and context_utilization_nonzero. SessionMetrics.TotalTokens has exactly ONE writer in the daemon — ParsedEvent.Tokens.Total via applyTokenSnapshot (tailer_metrics.go:127-133) — and the copilot parser fills it only from session.shutdown's data.currentTokens (parser.go:300-329). session.usage_checkpoint carries NO token counts at all (verified on a live 1.0.77 transcript: 4 checkpoints across 5 turns, data keys only {modelCacheState,totalNanoAiu,totalPremiumRequests}). With TotalTokens==0, computeContextUtilization (tailer_metrics.go:583-596) early-returns utilization=0/pressure=unknown and never assigns ContextWindow — so the capacity lookup is never reached even though the model is known and the table has the answer (gpt-5-mini→272000, claude-haiku-4.5→200000). Both fields therefore read 0 for a running session's whole life. This is bug, not incapable: the number IS on disk live, per turn, in ~/.copilot/session-store.db → assistant_usage_events.input_tokens (the full prompt size), keyed by the same session_id the adapter already uses; those rows precede session.shutdown by minutes (51ffced3: last row 20:48:16 vs shutdown 20:49:35; 40dfdd13: 17:22:52 vs 17:32:02). The fix has two precedents of exactly this shape — antigravity's sibling-SQLite store (#719/#766) and kiro-cli's sidecar reader (#599), the latter being why this scenario row exists at all. SECOND, INDEPENDENT BLOCKER: even once the daemon computes them, cmd/replay/metrics.go:59-63 copies total_tokens/context_window/context_utilization into the golden summary only for the antigravity adapter, so copilot's golden reports 0 regardless; both changes are needed before this cell goes green. NO exit_clean IN THE RECIPE, deliberately: session.shutdown is the one event carrying currentTokens, so a clean exit would hand replay a TotalTokens after the fact and make a post-hoc read look like the metric was available — masking the live gap this cell exists to pin. observations.model is NOT pinned: --model accepts only 'auto' on this account and the hydra router picks per turn (and can switch mid-session), so record fills it from the recording. Birth is anchored to start UNPINNED with no session pins: events.jsonl is not written until the first prompt is sent while the 1s process scanner may mint a transient proc-<PID> row first, so the shape validates under either ordering; record may re-template to the two-phase presession form if the recording shows a reconciliation.

text: The copilot session appears in ready (anchored UNPINNED to start: events.jsonl is only written at the first prompt, so a transient proc-<PID> pre-session may be born first; session.start is Skip=true, so a session coming into existence is not activity)
The trivial prompt opens the turn → working (user.message)

assistant.turn_end settles the turn back to ready. At this point the dashboard must show BOTH metrics: model_name is the router-resolved label (gpt-5-mini or claude-haiku-4.5), and context_window / context_utilization_percentage are > 0. The model half holds; the context half is the known failure — TotalTokens is still 0 because currentTokens arrives only at session.shutdown, which this recipe deliberately never triggers. --allow-all means the turn never enters waiting
